install: set -euo pipefail; touch ~/.bashrc; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; PYTHON_BIN=""; for cand in /opt/pyenv/versions/3.10.*/bin/python "$(command -v python3.10 2>/dev/null || true)" "$(command -v python3)"; do if [ -n "$cand" ] && [ -x "$cand" ]; then PYTHON_BIN="$cand"; break; fi; done; ([ -x .venv/bin/python ] && .venv/bin/python --version >/dev/null 2>&1) || "$PYTHON_BIN" -m venv .venv; VENV_LINE="export PATH=\"$(pwd)/.venv/bin:\$PATH\""; grep -qxF "$VENV_LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$VENV_LINE" >> ~/.bashrc; PIP_ARGS=(--no-input); if ! command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then PIP_ARGS+=(--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple); fi; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input --upgrade pip; .venv/bin/pip install "${PIP_ARGS[@]}" -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt; npm --prefix web/frontend ci --no-audit --no-fund
